bug_semantics: Remote-data DOM XSS in the MISP event browser: the server accepts an operator-selected remote MISP instance, copies that instance's event fields into JSON, and the browser interpolates those values into template strings assigned to innerHTML. A malicious or compromised remote MISP can therefore inject markup or script-capable content through event IDs, information, organization/date/count/threat fields, tag names and colors, TLP/distribution labels, or flash/error text; unvalidated tag colors also enter inline CSS.
flaw_origin: Commit b9f40af30de83fa44a14a3b0263df26192696b48 added the remote-MISP connection/browser feature and, in the same atomic commit, passed remote response fields through website/web/convert/convert.py and rendered them with div.innerHTML, overlay.innerHTML, and tr.innerHTML in website/web/templates/convert/misp_to_stix.html. The core mistake was treating remote-derived strings and colors as trusted HTML/CSS instead of creating DOM nodes and assigning textContent plus validating colors. Commit 26ecb7e6a608b5be73fa552928e00bef7cac4f22 later expanded selection/distribution behavior and added further instances of the same mechanism, but b9f40af30de83fa44a14a3b0263df26192696b48 is the earliest and smallest real BIC for the vulnerable event-browser mechanism.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object identifies author and committer as ecrou-exact <geffetheo@gmail.com> and contains only the subject 'add: [misp connection] can connect to a misp instance and select event to import'; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer/marker.
evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fh4x-m2h5-c6vx describes remote MISP values reaching HTML interpolation and references direct fix https://github.com/MISP/cti-transmute/commit/95e64137358d6fb7f1711523de2bf02ff6b181a7. Origin: `git log --all --reverse -S'${ev.info||' --` returns only b9f40af30de83fa44a14a3b0263df26192696b48 as the addition and 95e64137358d6fb7f1711523de2bf02ff6b181a7 as its removal; `git log -L 623,635:website/web/templates/convert/misp_to_stix.html b9f40af...` shows b9f40af... first adding the tr.innerHTML event-row interpolation. At the BIC, website/web/convert/convert.py:239 parses the remote response, lines 257 and 263-269 forward remote tag name/color, info, organization and tags, while website/web/templates/convert/misp_to_stix.html:486-507 interpolates flash msg into div.innerHTML, lines 525-564 interpolate tag names/colors into overlay.innerHTML, lines 598-615 build tag HTML, and lines 618-637 interpolate event fields into tr.innerHTML. Immediate-parent check: `git grep -F -e 'function miRenderRows' -e 'function showFlash' -e 'From MISP Instance' 4637cf8255487759ba648cff7e374d7c995468a5 -- website/web/templates/convert/misp_to_stix.html` returns no matches, while the same search at b9f40af... finds the feature at lines 77, 486 and 618 and tr.innerHTML at 623; the direct b9f40af... parent diff adds these lines. Commit-object check: `git cat-file -p b9f40af...` shows one parent, author=committer ecrou-exact <geffetheo@gmail.com>, and no trailers. Fix: 95e641... replaces rows with buildEventRow and textContent (website/web/templates/conversions/misp_to_stix.html:385,491,528; website/web/static/js/misp/mispEventRows.js:49,113) and constrains colors with /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ at line 7. Version boundary: `git tag --contains b9f40af...` gives v1.3, v1.4 and v1.5; `git tag --contains 95e641...` gives only v1.5. v1.3 still contains tr.innerHTML and ${ev.info||''}; v1.5 contains HEX_COLOUR, buildEventRow, and info.textContent. Thus the repository tags place the flaw in v1.3/v1.4 and the fix in v1.5, while the advisory itself lists affected/patched versions as Unknown.
reasoning: The attack path begins when an operator connects cti-transmute to a remote MISP. The BIC's backend requests /events/index, parses the remote JSON, and returns selected fields essentially verbatim; the BIC's frontend then embeds those fields into HTML strings assigned to innerHTML. This directly enables a remote MISP controller to break out of text/attribute/style contexts in the event table, TLP warning, or flash surface. Exact-string history and line history identify b9f40af30de83fa44a14a3b0263df26192696b48, not a later rename/refactor or the May 20 feature expansion, as the first writer of the vulnerable event-row and related rendering mechanism. Its immediate parent 4637cf8255487759ba648cff7e374d7c995468a5 has neither the remote-MISP browser nor its rendering functions, so parent absence is directly verified. The one-parent BIC is an ordinary coherent feature commit, not a squash aggregate requiring member decomposition. The vulnerability persists into v1.3 and v1.4; direct fix 95e64137358d6fb7f1711523de2bf02ff6b181a7 DOM-builds remote fields with textContent and validates tag colors, and is contained by v1.5. Finally, attribution is based only on the BIC commit object: it has a human author/committer and no AI marker or trailer. Under the protocol, that makes the closed verdict NOT_AI regardless of AI signals on unrelated commits.
